name: claim_check
_comment: Reference model for the task type claim_check (tasks_claims.json), one model
for all ten tasks. Written on 2026-10-26 before any run, from the task
statement alone ('compute the numbers from the data, have the result
independently verified'); its hash is in results/frozen/.
Activities are agent-qualified, Agent.activity, and a sub-agent start is
Parent.spawn:Child. check_claims.py does that relabelling before checking;
the log itself keeps plain tool names.
required    the numbers are computed by code (Coder.run_python), and the
Analyst starts both sub-agents, each of which uses its own tool:
DataChecker reads the data, Recalculator recomputes it
precedence  verification comes after the computation it verifies
